The '''''Liberty''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] fleet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Liberty_bridge.png|thumb|left|200px|General Aayla Secura on the ''Liberty''{{'s}} bridge]]
The ''Liberty''<ref name="Decoded" /> was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="CCS" /> the ''Liberty'' had several [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret]]s, at least one [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] equipped, a pair of [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]], and [[Engine/Legends|engines]] equipped. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] also had a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] built into its belly, large enough to fit a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|Charger c70 retrofitted]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]]. The belly hangar bay also had an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] that allowed other [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to dock with the ''Liberty''.<ref name="Jedi Crash" />

==History==
During the [[Sky Battle of Quell]], General Secura's fleet was attacked by several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] under the command of a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]]. All three [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] sustained heavy damage and called for aide from General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]], who quickly arrived with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Yularen]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']].

The ''Resolute'' arrived in time to launch three [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] to board the ''Liberty'' and extract all Republic personnel. [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|Rocket droids]] took notice of the new arrivals and were distracted enough to break off and intercept them. Skywalker, Tano and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] joined Secura and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] in fighting the droids aboard their cruiser. However, the Separatist tactical droid commander, too impatient to wait for the rocket droids to finish their mission, ordered the cruiser destroyed. Skywalker called a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class]] [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|frigate]] for the evacuation, and sacrificed himself to save the others from a raging inferno caused by the increasing laser fire. Tano and Secura managed to drag him aboard the frigate shortly before the cruiser was destroyed.
